title: Introduce per-segment latency trellis and log entropy filter for long-tail reduction
author: Linh Tran
body: Context: We continue to see noisy long-tail latency alerts where aggregated percentiles obscure per-segment (prefix / KV-cache warmness / batch-size) behavior. This PR introduces a lightweight per-segment 'latency trellis' rollup plus a log entropy-based filter to suppress low-signal alerts from high-cardinality noisy routes. Motivation: reduce alert fatigue, surface actionable regressions, and provide a compact dashboard for investigating tail behavior at the segment level. Summary of changes: 1) telemetry/rollups: add TrellisBuilder that buckets requests by segment keys (prefix_hash, kv_hit, batch_bin) and emits downsampled reservoir histograms keyed by segment_id; 2) tracing/span-enrichment: attach segment_id and entropy_score to sampling spans to enable correlation between logs and trellis buckets; 3) logging/filter: implement LogEntropyFilter which computes a rolling entropy score per route and suppresses low-information log flaps from surfacing as incidents; 4) dashboards: add dashboards/latency-trellis.jsonnet with segment heatmap, top-entropy routes, and quick drilldowns to traces; 5) alerts: introduce tuned alert rule 'trellis_long_tail_anomaly' that uses segment-level anomaly score and an entropy gate to reduce false positives; 6) tests: unit and integration tests for trellis aggregation and entropy filter, plus a synthetic SLO replay in perf-canary. Implementation details: TrellisBuilder operates as an incremental aggregator inside the telemetry ingestion pipeline and emits compact rollups every 30s; reservoir histograms are bounded to 256 samples to control cardinality. segment_id is a deterministic 64-bit hash of the tuple (route, prefix_bucket, kv_hit, batch_bin) so it is stable across rollouts. Entropy is approximated with a small fixed-window counting sketch (64 counters) to keep memory bounded per route. Rollout plan: 1) deploy trellis rollups in staging for 48h; 2) enable dashboard in read-only for SRE and product; 3) enable alert gating at 10% of traffic and monitor false-positive rate for 72h; 4) full rollout on success. Backwards compatibility: recorded metrics are namespace-prefixed with telemetry.trellis.v1 so older dashboards remain unchanged. Testing and CI: added unit tests and an integration test that replays synthetic sessions to validate segment-level percentiles; one flaky histogram serialization test was rerun in CI and passed on second attempt (CI status: pass). Review notes and trade-offs: reservoir histograms trade exactness for bounded storage; entropy gate reduces signal for very low-traffic noisy routes which risks missing rare regressions — we tuned thresholds conservatively and included an override label to force bypass per-route in the console. Observability additions: new metrics telemetry.trellis.segment_latency_p50/p95/p99, telemetry.trellis.segment_count, telemetry.trellis.segment_entropy; tracing enrichment fields segment_id and entropy_score; dashboard and alert definitions included. Related work: complements ENG-1173 (kv-cache profiler) and PM-442 (long-tail alerting improvements). Checklist: ; [x] unit tests added; [x] integration test added; [x] dashboard JSONnet included; [x] alert rule added with gradual rollout; [x] migration notes and docs updated. Please see commits summary and file list below.
commits: 4 commits: 1) Add TrellisBuilder core aggregation and reservoir histograms; 2) Attach segment_id and entropy_score to sampled spans; 3) Implement LogEntropyFilter and add unit tests; 4) Add dashboards and alert rules + docs and perf replay test.
review_thread: Reviewer Marta: 'Can you clarify memory profile at 1M routes?'; Author Linh: 'We bound per-route sketch to 64 counters and shard state; memory projection added to docs and is ~120MB for 1M active routes in worst case; see docs/observability/memory_projection.md'; Reviewer Lucas: 'Prefer metric names without deep nesting' -> Author: 'Kept telemetry.trellis.v1 to allow future schema changes; provided compatibility shim'; Reviewer Priya: 'Alert threshold looks aggressive for low-volume routes' -> Author: 'Added entropy gate and per-route override label; added canary at 10% traffic.'; Final: Approved by Marta and Lucas, Priya requested one small rename in alert docs which was applied.
release_notes: Introduce per-segment latency trellis rollups and log-entropy filter to reduce long-tail alert noise and provide segment-level latency insights. New metrics and dashboard added. Configurable entropy gate for alerts.
notes_for_qa: Run perf-canary replay with provided synthetic sessions; verify trellis segment buckets appear in telemetry backend; validate that entropy filter suppresses noise on designated noisy-route fixture; check dashboard heatmap and trace drilldowns.
ci_artifacts: Unit tests (telemetry, logging) and integration replay; one flaky histogram-serialize test rerun and passed; coverage: +2.1% on telemetry package.
merge_outcome: squash merged after approvals and CI green. Deployed to staging and then to prod via gradual rollout as described.
